entries.48c0a86516de8c1e: Under a three-year medium-term plan with the fiscal year ending March 2027 as its final year, it sets three pillars of strategy: 'evolution of the existing business model', 'improvement of management efficiency' and 'creation of innovation'. Under the evolution of the existing business model, it positions the fresh food division, centered on deli, seafood, produce and livestock, as the axis of growth, and is advancing product development and sales floor proposal capabilities, a fundamental strengthening of the deli division, and building 'stores people want to visit every day' based on EDRP. The 70th fiscal period is also positioned as a run-up period for the next three-year medium-term plan, and under the strategic policy 'Fresh Drives Growth', it states that it is advancing a shift to management centered on sales growth.

With fresh food as its main focus, it develops and sells 'YAMANAKA Original' products, and also operates the quality-oriented store brands 'Frante' and 'Frante Rose'. It is also characterized by a structure in which the group handles everything from food manufacturing to sales, including receiving supply of daily perishables and cooked rice from its consolidated subsidiary Sunday Daily Co., Ltd.
